text.arabic_uthmani: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening a descriptive imperfect clause; not a prohibitive command
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) opens the ayah by making absence the first instruction the reader receives. Because it negates the following imperfect verb, the clause describes an ongoing state of non-hearing rather than a command not to listen. Its scope organizes the heard-content list under one negative frame, while the later repeated negator gives the short ayah an audible and logical neither-nor shape.

topics.headline: opening descriptive negation
topics.summary: The first negator governs an imperfect verb and makes the absence of hearing a continuing state.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is describing a purified environment, not commanding residents to avoid listening.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) as a negative particle before an indicative imperfect verb, supporting descriptive negation over prohibition.

topics.headline: single negative frame
topics.summary: The opening negator launches one integrated clause whose scope reaches the later heard objects.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the two excluded speech types as parts of one soundscape denial rather than separate moral remarks.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies a single verbal clause in which the negated verb governs the locative and both objects.

topics.headline: negative bookend
topics.summary: The first negator is answered by the second negator before the final object, making the neither-nor structure audible.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears negation return before the close, so the final excluded content is not merely carried by the first denial.
topics.reason: The repeated negative particle is visible in the word sequence and separately scopes the second coordinated object.

words.gloss_range: they hear, receive, or encounter sound; locally negated as ordinary auditory reception of defective speech
words.root_gloss_range: broad hearing field including perception, listening, understanding, response, reputation, and caused hearing; the local verb selects basic reception under negation
words.prose: {{ar:يَسْمَعُونَ}} ({{tr:yasmaʿūna}}) makes the reward-space a lived auditory condition: they do not receive these sounds as an ongoing state. The plural ending keeps the inhabitants present without repeating their noun, while the single verb governs the place phrase and both excluded objects. The root field can extend from hearing toward response, but the local Form I imperfect and its objects narrow the payoff to basic reception of speech-content: the environment removes the corrupt sound before attention, answer, or social reaction can begin. The formula also joins other paradise soundscape passages that negate hearing void speech (19:62; 78:35), with this ayah expanding the frame to include guilt-attribution.

topics.headline: imperfect plural state
topics.summary: The imperfect plural verb describes continuing non-exposure for the inhabitants.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same group moves into a continuing condition of protected perception.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an imperfect 3mp verb, and attachment evidence resolves the implicit subject from the discourse.

topics.headline: ordinary reception narrowed
topics.summary: The broader hearing-response field survives as pressure, but local grammar selects ordinary reception of speech-content.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that paradise removes corrupt speech at the level of reception, before it can demand attention or response.
topics.reason: V4 supports hearing and compliance within the broad root field, while the local finite verb with explicit speech objects selects auditory or communicative reception rather than caused hearing, reputation, or bodily-ear senses.

topics.headline: single verb governance
topics.summary: One perception verb governs the locative phrase and both excluded content nouns.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one purified soundscape with two barred contents, not two separate events.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the place phrase as complement of the verb and both later nouns as explicit objects under the same verbal head.

topics.headline: paradise hearing formula
topics.summary: The negated hearing construction participates in a repeated paradise soundscape formula.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes auditory purity as a recurring paradise marker, with this ayah adding moral accusation to the excluded field.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete parallels at 19:62 and 78:35, and contextual profiles show the local root-form frequently appears under negation.

topics.headline: reward boundary shift
topics.summary: The verb marks the move from prior earned action into present sensory immunity.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recompense becomes concrete as what the rewarded group no longer has to hear.
topics.reason: The plural subject continues the prior discourse group while the imperfect verb describes their current state.

topics.headline: sound movement
topics.summary: The smoother hearing verb yields to heavier sounds in the excluded objects.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the clause move from receptive softness into the rougher material that the ayah excludes.
topics.reason: The surface sequence supplies the phonetic contrast noted in the CRITICAL row.

words.gloss_range: in it, within that feminine antecedent realm; locally the garden setting of the hearing clause
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) turns the negation into a spatially anchored soundscape. The attached feminine suffix retrieves the already established garden realm, and the preposition makes the absence where-bound rather than a universal claim about speech everywhere. Because the phrase intervenes between the verb and the objects, the reader receives the place before the two excluded categories: the realm itself is presented as the filter.

topics.headline: contained domain
topics.summary: The locative phrase places the non-hearing inside the established realm; any noun-qualification reading remains secondary to the licensed verb complement.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah defines what is absent inside that realm, not what never exists anywhere.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses the phrase as a locative complement of the hearing verb; the broader speech-location possibility is retained only as semantic support.

topics.headline: pronoun reanchoring
topics.summary: The attached feminine suffix ties the soundscape back to the prior garden setting without repeating the noun.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the auditory claim attached to the previously described reward-space.
topics.reason: The word is a preposition plus feminine singular suffix, and attachment evidence supplies the garden setting as antecedent.

topics.headline: place before content
topics.summary: The locative phrase appears before the heard objects, foregrounding where before what.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first imagines the realm, then learns which sounds are excluded from it.
topics.reason: The surface order places the locative word between the verb and the two accusative objects.

words.gloss_range: vain, void, purposeless, or non-binding speech; locally an indefinite heard object excluded from the realm
words.root_gloss_range: broad range around discarded or uncounted speech, vain or false utterance, clamor, preoccupation, deviation, and failure; local grammar selects speech-content while allowing the null-signal pressure
words.prose: {{ar:لَغْوًۭا}} ({{tr:laghwan}}) is not the residents' speech but the first accusative object that would have been heard. Its indefinite verbal-noun shape makes the excluded class general: no instance of void, purposeless, non-binding speech enters the soundscape. The broader root field includes raw sound and failed or discarded utterance, but the hearing frame narrows the local sense to speech-content that fails to bind, guide, or accomplish anything. As the first pole before the renewed negation, it sets the baseline defect that is then escalated to guilt-attribution; the repeated paradise echoes at 19:62, 52:23, 78:35, and 88:11 make this absence a recognizable soundscape marker.

topics.headline: heard accusative object
topics.summary: The word is an indefinite accusative object of hearing, with the locative pressure retained as domain coloring rather than primary attachment.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah excludes this speech from what reaches the inhabitants, not merely from what they say.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly marks the noun as a direct object of the hearing verb; the possible locative coloring is narrowed by that local syntax.

topics.headline: void speech root pressure
topics.summary: The broad root field gives the word null, failed, and non-binding force, while local grammar selects purposeless speech-content.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the excluded object as speech that sounds like utterance but contributes no binding meaning.
topics.reason: V4 supports discarded, vain, false, and noisy branches, but the local direct-object relation under hearing selects speech-content over unrelated failure or mere animal-sound senses.

topics.headline: generic verbal-noun class
topics.summary: The singular indefinite verbal noun under negation excludes the whole act-type.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands that the ayah bars the category as such, not one known utterance or one speaker.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as an accusative singular indefinite verbal noun, and contextual profiles show this form is a recurring term.

topics.headline: paradise formula echo
topics.summary: The word participates in repeated paradise passages where void speech is absent.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the absence of void speech as a repeated Quranic marker of paradise, with this ayah pairing it with guilt-attribution.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete paradise parallels at 19:62, 52:23, 78:35, and 88:11.

topics.headline: first pole escalation
topics.summary: The first object establishes purposeless speech before the sequence moves to morally damaging speech.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ordered movement from empty speech to harmful blame-speech instead of a flat synonym pair.
topics.reason: The word precedes the coordinator and shares accusative indefinite form with the final object while retaining a distinct root field.

words.gloss_range: and; locally the coordinator that adds the second negated object under the same hearing verb
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge between the two excluded objects. Its local work is coordination, not a circumstantial clause: it adds the second object under the same hearing verb after the first object is complete. Joined with the following negator, it prevents the final category from being absorbed into the first; the recitation resets before the heavier moral exclusion lands.

topics.headline: coordinated second object
topics.summary: The particle coordinates the second object under the same verb; simultaneity remains only a secondary pressure.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees two parallel barred contents rather than a main object plus background circumstance.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a conjunction coordinating the second object with the first, narrowing broader circumstantial possibilities.

topics.headline: renewed negation hinge
topics.summary: The coordinator gains force with the following negator, adding the second object while reopening denial.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the movement from empty speech to guilt-speech as addition plus a fresh exclusion.
topics.reason: The surface sequence is tokenized as conjunction followed by a second negative particle, and the attachment evidence keeps the final noun independently negated.

words.gloss_range: second negative particle renewing negation before the final accusative object
words.prose: The second {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) gives the final object its own negative operator. It does not govern a jussive verb; it renews object-scope negation before an accusative verbal noun, turning a simple list into a balanced neither-nor frame. Bound to the preceding coordinator, it fuses addition with renewed denial; its return also bookends the clause with the opening negator and prepares the next ayah's restricted positive saying in 56:26.

topics.headline: independent object negation
topics.summary: The repeated negator separately denies the final accusative object and is not prohibitive.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guilt-attribution is barred on its own terms, not only by being bundled with the first object.
topics.reason: The word precedes an accusative verbal noun rather than a jussive verb, and attachment evidence marks that noun as the second coordinated object.

topics.headline: neither-nor cadence
topics.summary: The repeated negator turns coordination into a balanced, audible neither-nor structure.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the logical separation as recitational balance across the short ayah.
topics.reason: The surface repeats the same negative particle before the final object, creating a visible and audible pair.

topics.headline: bound bookend
topics.summary: The second negator is bound to the preceding coordinator and echoes the opening negator near closure.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees addition and renewed denial fused at the point where the final excluded sound arrives.
topics.reason: The local sequence places the conjunction immediately before the second negator while the first negator remains the clause opener.

topics.headline: exception preparation
topics.summary: The double negation clears the speech field before the positive exception in 56:26.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader expects the next ayah's permitted speech to fill a field just emptied by the double denial.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply the concrete forward relation to 56:26, and the local ayah is structured as paired negation.

words.gloss_range: sin-charging, guilt-attribution, or blame-speech; locally the final indefinite accusative object heard under renewed negation
words.root_gloss_range: root field of sin, guilt, moral offense, sinnerhood, and accusation; local Form II verbal noun selects the act of assigning guilt rather than a bare state of sin
words.prose: {{ar:تَأْثِيمًا}} ({{tr:taʾthīman}}) closes the ayah as the heavier excluded sound. Grammatically it is a second indefinite accusative object of hearing, not a cognate accusative or an abstract state floating outside the verb. Lexically, the Form II verbal noun selects the act of charging someone with sin: blame-speech and guilt-attribution are removed from what can be heard. The root's burden image makes that exclusion more concrete, since accusation loads a person with moral weight; paradise is free from that imposed burden. Its pairing with the first object recurs at 52:23, while the close of this ayah moves from purposeless speech to morally damaging speech and prepares the positive peace-saying of 56:26.

topics.headline: heard final object
topics.summary: The final word is the second indefinite accusative object under the hearing verb and renewed negation.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guilt-attribution is excluded as heard content, not merely as a moral idea.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as an accusative verbal noun and second direct object governed by the hearing verb.

topics.headline: Form II accusation
topics.summary: The derived verbal noun selects blame-speech and guilt-attribution, while broader sin and sinner senses remain background.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah removing accusatory speech, not just naming sin in general.
topics.reason: The local form is a Form II verbal noun according to QAC; V4 has no root rows for this root, so the CRITICAL lexical distinction is retained with local grammatical narrowing.

topics.headline: guilt burden image
topics.summary: The root image of impediment colors accusation as a burdening speech act, without replacing the selected Form II sense.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final exclusion as removal of blame imposed on someone, not only removal of a label.
topics.reason: With no V4 root guardrail available, the CRITICAL root-image pressure is preserved as coloring of the locally selected accusation sense.

topics.headline: moral valence family
topics.summary: The root family supplies sin, guilt, and sinnerhood as the moral field, while the local derivative names the act of assigning that guilt.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final object as morally charged accusation rather than neutral fault-finding.
topics.reason: The broader root-family claims are kept as semantic field pressure, but local Form II verbal-noun morphology prevents reading the word as a sinner adjective or self-restraint form.

topics.headline: formulaic pair
topics.summary: The final word forms the second half of a rare paradise formula paired with the first excluded object.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes sin-charging as part of a known paradise speech-ethics formula, especially through the parallel at 52:23.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give 52:23 as the concrete formulaic parallel and identify this derivative as rare in the supplied evidence.

topics.headline: closing escalation
topics.summary: The final position lands on the heavier moral category after the first excluded object.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah close not with empty chatter but with the sharper exclusion of morally damaging speech.
topics.reason: The word is last in the ayah, follows the first accusative object, and carries the heavier moral field described by the CRITICAL rows.

topics.headline: reward and peace bridge
topics.summary: The final exclusion answers just recompense and points forward to the peace-saying in 56:26.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the negative soundscape prepare the positive speech that remains in 56:26.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide the immediate backward link to recompense and the forward link to 56:26.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The double negation governs what reaches hearing: laghw and ta'thim.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse excludes both low-value sonic disorder and high-stakes moral injury from the residents' auditory field.

activation_trace.role: Ear-level perception makes reception, rather than only speaker conduct, the mechanism's entry point.
Mixed, disruptive sound supplies the low-information acoustic pole excluded from the setting.
Assigning or loading guilt supplies the personally injurious speech act excluded at the other pole.

changed_reading.before: They hear no idle or sinful talk.
changed_reading.after: Nothing entering their hearing is either disordered empty sound or speech that burdens a person with guilt.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Sama can involve understanding and acceptance, while laghw and ta'thim form opposite failures of meaningful exchange.
baseline_models.mechanism: Laghw is speech that does not count; ta'thim is speech that counts guilt against someone. Their joint absence yields discourse that is meaningful without becoming prosecutorial.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and responsive acceptance turn hearing into consequential uptake.
What is discarded or not reckoned supplies the null side of the discourse economy.
Counting guilt against another supplies the coercive overcharge opposed to null speech.

changed_reading.before: The verse bans two bad categories of speech.
changed_reading.after: The verse defines an exchange with neither speech too null to count nor speech that makes another answer to a guilt-charge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The heard objects can be tracked by laghw as deviation and ithm as delay from good.
baseline_models.mechanism: Auditory input normally can bend attention away from the right course and slow movement toward good; the negation removes both directional and temporal obstruction.

activation_trace.role: Receptive understanding makes heard speech capable of directing subsequent response.
Deviation from what is right gives laghw a directional effect on attention.
Delay from good gives ta'thim a temporal drag rather than only a forbidden content label.

changed_reading.before: No morally bad utterance is audible.
changed_reading.after: No heard utterance can deflect attention from the right course or retard movement toward good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening's impact-sound and shaking that can confuse speech establish an acoustically disintegrative world; the focus negation then reads as a post-upheaval soundscape in which no mixed verbal impact lands.

activation_trace.role: Impact and its sound give the opening event an audible force that the later auditory scene reverses.
Shaking that renders speech confused links material convulsion to verbal unintelligibility.
Collective or thunder-like sound intensifies the noisy pole from which the focus setting differs.
Direct audition locates the contextual reversal in what can reach the ear.
Mixed noise names the disordered acoustic quality absent after the opening convulsion.

structural_cues: The opening repeats event and shaking roots within 56:1 and 56:4, creating emphatic impacts before the focus's paired negation.
The locative fiha confines the auditory condition to the newly described garden setting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies impact-sound and shaken or confused sound; I infer a transition from disintegrative noise to ordered audition, while the live alternative is a simple contrast between unrelated scenes.

changed_reading.before: The garden is free of bad conversation.
changed_reading.after: After a world announced by impact and convulsive sound, the garden is an ordered auditory domain where disintegrative noise no longer arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: Face-to-face orientation, circulation through the gathering, pleasant talk, and the following repeated peace turn the negation into a rule for social flow: speech remains present and pleasurable but cannot degrade into ugliness or blame.

activation_trace.role: Mutual facing creates a direct interpersonal channel in which speech would circulate.
Movement around the gathering supplies circulation as the social mechanism's spatial form.
Pleasant, witty talk activates a positive vocal alternative to laghw rather than mere silence.
Ugly, false, or insulting speech marks the relational corruption barred from circulation.
Loading guilt onto another marks the accusatory corruption barred from face-to-face exchange.
Actual voiced saying confirms that the scene is vocal and supplies the positive content channel.
Reconciliation rather than conflict gives the repeated utterance its relational force.

structural_cues: Muttaqabilin and yatufu place persons in mutual orientation and circulating motion before the auditory negation.
The immediate illa qilan salaman salama supplies voiced positive replacement, with peace repeated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies facing, circulation, pleasant talk, voiced saying, and peace; I infer that discourse participates in the gathering's circulation, while the alternative is that salaman is only a fixed formula.

changed_reading.before: Paradise is quiet because bad speech is absent.
changed_reading.after: The gathering is socially vocal: face-to-face speech circulates, but nothing in that circulation insults, accuses, or morally burdens another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired negatives align two intake channels: drink reaches the body without headache or depletion, and speech reaches hearing without noisy or moral residue.

activation_trace.role: The cup together with its contents establishes bodily intake as the first reception channel.
Headache supplies the damaging bodily aftereffect explicitly removed from drink.
Hearing establishes the parallel sensory intake channel.
Mixed noise supplies a cognitive-acoustic residue that never follows hearing.
Imposed guilt supplies a moral aftereffect that never follows speech.

structural_cues: 56:19 and 56:25 share the la ... wa-la frame, first for drink's effects and then for heard speech.
The branchless root ن ز ف at 56:19[5] supports depletion only as a structural cue beside headache.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cup, negated headache and depletion, hearing, and negated verbal harms; I infer an analogy between consequence-free bodily and verbal reception, while the alternative is a list of independent amenities.

changed_reading.before: Harmless drink and polite speech are separate comforts.
changed_reading.after: Drink and speech are paired forms of intake whose bodily, cognitive, and moral aftereffects have all been removed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The residents actively select and desire beneficial consumables, whereas harmful auditory objects are absent before any filtering choice is required; agency is preserved for goods while exposure to verbal harm is prevented.

activation_trace.role: Choosing what is good supplies active selection on the desirable side of the sensory field.
The soul's movement toward what it desires supplies positive appetite without compulsion.
Auditory reception supplies the contrasting channel in which no harmful object arrives.
Discardable content represents unwanted intake that never needs to be screened out.
Guilt-loading represents coercive intake barred at the source.

structural_cues: The parallel mimma yatakhayyaruna and mimma yashtahuna clauses foreground chosen and desired goods immediately before the auditory negation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies active choice and desire followed by non-hearing; I infer an asymmetry between freely chosen goods and precluded verbal harm, while the alternative is that the sensory clauses are merely cumulative.

changed_reading.before: Residents or speakers successfully avoid bad conversation.
changed_reading.after: Residents retain active desire and selection for goods, but the habitat does not expose them to speech they would have to reject or endure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recompense has already mapped intended action to consequence. The next verse therefore excludes both discourse that falls outside reckoning and discourse that reopens the account by charging guilt.

activation_trace.role: Matching an action with its recompense supplies the settled action-consequence relation.
Collection and satisfaction of a debt sharpen recompense into an account brought to completion.
Intended action supplies what the recompense answers rather than an arbitrary reward.
Consequential uptake makes the condition a social order, not only an acoustic fact.
What is not counted supplies one excluded failure of the completed moral economy.
Charging guilt supplies the opposite excluded act of reopening another's moral account.

structural_cues: 56:24 places recompense for what they did immediately before the paired objects laghwan and ta'thiman.
The two focus nouns can be read as an accounting polarity: what is not reckoned and what reckons guilt.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, intended action, debt satisfaction, and the two accounting-capable focus branches; I infer ledger closure, while the live alternative is that 56:24 states only the reward's cause.

changed_reading.before: The verse prescribes refined speech etiquette.
changed_reading.after: It describes a post-recompense society where speech is neither meaningless to the account nor able to prosecute someone by opening a new guilt-charge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because direct hearing is shifted toward public reputation and the lowering or raising pair is shifted toward social rank. It remains anchored in the packet's sama reputation branch, the focus's guilt-loading branch, and 56:3's explicit status poles; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary sociological resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yasma'una and ta'thiman can jointly evoke hearing about a person and speech that publicly fixes guilt.

activation_trace.role: Lowering after height supplies one status movement that reputational speech could otherwise perform.
Elevation of standing supplies the opposite status movement.
Broadcasting news connects elevation language to public circulation of reputation.
Reputation and public notoriety make hearing a social-status channel.
Publicly assigning guilt supplies the speech act that could lower standing.

changed_reading.before: No one hears offensive or sinful words.
changed_reading.after: No reputational broadcast can lower or raise residents through accusation; the event has settled standing beyond public talk.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant q-w-l to q-l-l mapping, so it is surprising and must not replace the ordinary sense of qilan as saying. It remains anchored because 56:26 immediately resolves what is heard with qilan and repeated peace; render it only as an echo of sparse or concentrated speech.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus negates what is heard, and the immediately following exception supplies qilan as its positive remainder.

activation_trace.role: Auditory perception provides the field whose positive remainder may be quantitatively inflected.
Discarded excess supplies what concentrated speech leaves out.
The non-dominant scarcity branch contributes an echo of little, concentrated speech to the positive exception.
Safety from harm gives that concentrated remainder its repeated content.

changed_reading.before: All speech is purified into peaceful speech.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch echo, the soundscape may also be sparse: little speech is needed, and its concentrated remainder is repeated peace.

strongest_changes: The verse became the speech-side analogue of 56:19: reception without damaging aftereffects.
Face-to-face, circulating hospitality and repeated peace made the scene socially vocal rather than merely silent.
Immediate recompense recast ta'thim as a closed guilt-accounting operation, paired with laghw as what never counts.
Opening impact and confused sound sharpened the garden as an ordered post-upheaval soundscape.
summary.what_was_special: The tightest activation came from functional pairings: two intake channels, a spatial conversation network, and an accounting polarity between the uncounted and the guilt-counting.
remaining_uncertainties: The cosmic-sound link depends on reading the opening material disturbances acoustically across the pericope.
Ledger closure is an inference from adjacency, not an explicit claim that accusation has procedurally ended.
The q-w-l to q-l-l outlier is only a non-dominant branch echo, not a lexical substitution.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A protected auditory field.** `س م ع` **B001** supplies hearing sounds, `ل غ و` **B002** vain, false, or foul speech, and `ء ث م` **B004** charging or loading sin onto someone. The prior face-to-face arrangement and following doubled peace define what replaces the excluded speech. **Abductive move:** I infer that the environment prevents harmful utterance from entering circulation. **Reading change:** the ayah describes social protection from both empty noise and accusatory moral loading.

2. **Nothing heard is discarded as non-counting.** `ل غ و` **B001** supplies what is set aside as not counting, while `س م ع` **B003** supplies understanding and compliance. **Abductive move:** I infer that speech in this setting is meaningful and receivable because the following `سلام` exhausts what is said. **Reading change:** the negation removes communicative waste, not merely rude vocabulary.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The dissembling and denial of 56:81–82 showed that harmful speech remains possible outside this protected field and can deform one’s relation to provision.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The reward includes an auditory commons free of nullification and moral loading.** `س م ع` (B001, hearing sounds; B003, understanding and compliance) is denied contact with `ل غ و` (B001, what does not count; B002, vain or foul speech) and `ء ث م` (B004, charging or loading sin onto someone). Ayat 20–24 fill bodily desire without harm; ayah 26 supplies the sole heard utterance. I infer that social well-being requires speech that neither wastes attention nor implicates hearers. The line reads as environmental purification, not simple quiet.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 56:81–82 shows speech being softened evasively and then turned into falsification, confirming that the cleansed auditory commons excludes epistemic distortion and moral loading, not noise alone.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1 Reward as a Protected, Circulating Court
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Recompense is materialized as an ordered court whose enclosure, service, intake, beauty, and speech are protected from decay, depletion, and antagonism.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The scene combines royal access, furnishing craft, controlled circulation, non-depleting consumption, and a regulated speech environment rather than offering an undifferentiated luxury inventory.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Compensation closes accusation into peace
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Deliberate work receives matching recompense, and the resulting social soundscape excludes discarded or guilt-loading speech in favor of safety and peace.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: matching recompense `quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`; intentional work `quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`; hearing speech `quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`; discarded speech `quranic:root_001361:B001/m01`; foul or accusatory speech `quranic:root_001361:B002/m01`; loading guilt onto another `quranic:root_000013:B004/m01`; articulated utterance `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; safety from harm `quranic:root_000737:B001/m01`; peace opposed to conflict `quranic:root_000737:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The court's moral economy matches outcome to purposeful action, then removes the verbal mechanisms that reopen conflict: noise without value, obscenity, and imputed guilt. What remains audible is a repeated declaration of intactness and peace.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1-P5 Directed Transmission from Disclosure to Arrival
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What is sent becomes effective through a directed chain from source and disclosure through carrier, channel, marked route, and intended reception.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Oral publication and physical courier movement share one delivery architecture; the wish that unwelcome news be heard without reaching its subject isolates failed arrival as the reversal of successful transmission.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A report is released, heard, and blocked from its subject
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A report is disclosed, broadcast from its source, and made audible to others, while paired formulas seek to prevent the unwelcome news from reaching the person concerned.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: disclosure and public showing `quranic:root_000299:B006/m01`; broadcasting a report from its speaker `quranic:root_000582:B005/m01`; causing another to hear `quranic:root_000741:B004/m01`; wish that bad news be heard but not reach its subject `quranic:root_000741:B011/m01`, `quranic:root_000151:B009/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Across P1, P2, and P5, the bridge is a causal transmission sequence: disclosure, broadcast, caused hearing, and attempted non-arrival. Human agents may try to control whether ordinary news reaches its addressee; that failed-delivery formula usefully pressures the primary reading, in which neither the discourse nor the report enacted at death can be kept from its terminal subject.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü kova ve büyük su kabındaki halka ya da sapı temel alırken, aynı adın kabın yanları, sapın kaba uzanan bölümü ve yük sepetindeki iki tahta için de kullanıldığını gösterir. Dal doğrudur, ancak bütün parçalar tek bir biçimsel parça sayılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel gönderim kova veya su kabındaki taşıma ve dengeleme parçasıdır; yan, uzantı ve sepet tahtası kullanımları ayrı türlerdir.

concept_map.definition: Kova, büyük su kabı veya benzeri bir taşıma kabında tutma, bağlama ya da yükü dengeleme işlevi gören halka, sap, yan parça veya tahta elemandır. Yapma bildiren söz öbeği, kovaya böyle bir parça eklemeyi ya da saplarını yükü hafifletecek biçimde bağlamayı anlatır.

facets.statement: Parça bir taşıma kabını tutmaya, bağlamaya veya yükünü dengelemeye yarar.
Parça halka, iç sap, kabın yanı, sapın kaba uzanan bölümü veya sepet tahtası olarak tanımlanabilir.
Ettirgen söz öbeği kovaya bu parçayı eklemeyi veya saplarını yükü hafifletecek biçimde düzenlemeyi bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar taşıma kabındaki halka veya sapı ortak merkez olarak verir; yan parça, sap uzantısı ve sepet tahtası tanımları bu araçsal parçanın değişik gerçekleşmeleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü hayvanı kimi yerde kurt ile sırtlan arasında bir yırtıcı veya melez, kimi yerde kurdun sırtlandan olan yavrusu diye tanımlar. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu tanımlar tek ve kesin bir çağdaş hayvan sınıflandırması gibi sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tarihsel ad, kurt ile sırtlan arasında tasarlanan yırtıcıyı gösterir; keskin işitme üzerine söz yalnız bu hayvana bağlı kalıptır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın hayvan adı ile onun keskin işitmesini örnek veren karşılaştırma kalıbı ayrılır; kalıp genel işitme anlamına dönüştürülmez.

Hayvanın adı, keskin işitmeyi anlatan bir karşılaştırma kalıbında kullanılır.

facets.statement: Bir şey değersiz, gereksiz veya geçersiz görülür ve bu nedenle dikkate alınmaz, hesaba katılmaz ya da işlemden çıkarılır.

facets.statement: Söz batıl, çirkin, açık saçık, sövgü niteliğinde veya günaha yol açan içerik taşır.

facets.statement: Kişi bir şeye düşkün olur, ona bağlanır ve onunla sürekli meşgul olur.

Bir topluluğun sürekli kullandığı söz düzeni ve aynı anlamı başka sözlerle anlatma biçimi, yerleşmiş dil anlamını oluşturur.
Bir topluluğun konuşmasını soru sormadan dinleyerek onların dil kullanımı öğrenilebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar bir şeye düşkün olma ve içeceği çok tüketme anlamlarını verir; dil anlamını bir topluluğun sürekli kullandığı sözlerle ve aynı anlamın farklı sözlerle anlatılmasıyla açıklar. Ayrıca konuşmayı doğrudan dinleyerek dil kullanımını edinme eylemi aktarılır.

concept_map.definition: Köksel açıklama yavaşlama ve geri kalmadır; somut kullanım, dişi devenin geri kalmasını veya ağır ilerlemesini bildiren öbekle sınırlıdır. Bundan, kişiyi iyilikten ya da ödülden geri bırakan yanlış eylem ve böyle bir eylemi işleyen kişinin niteliği türetilir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, hareket veya ilerleyişte yavaşlama ve geride kalmadır.
Belirli bir hayvan yapısında dişi devenin geri kalması veya ağır ilerlemesi anlatılır.

Bu yanlış eylemi yapan, yükünü taşıyan veya çokça işleyen kişi de aynı anlam çevresindeki nitelemelerle gösterilir.
